sloka: उद्भ्रान्तचित्तस्तां दृष्ट्वा विषण्णो ऽहमरिन्दम।तदहं भवतो वृत्तं विज्ञापयितुमागतः ।। ६.८३.९ ।।
transliteration: udbhrāntacittastāṁ dṛṣṭvā viṣaṇṇo 'hamarindama।tadahaṁ bhavato vṛttaṁ vijñāpayitumāgataḥ ।। 6.83.9 ।।

translations.english: "O Tamer of enemies! Seeing her (Sita) bewildered in mind, worried, I have come to inform you accompanied by Vanaras."
